purpose: Primary-paper-informed, small candidate set; retrospective chronological verification, no automatic model adoption
no_proxy_substitution: Do not substitute the large market-only archive for actual tipster/score comparisons
source: PR422 normalized TIMED and VOTES frozen input frames, referenced original hashes; all exposed in earlier work, not fresh holdout
primary_forecast_snapshot: Latest full event frame observed at least 30min before kickoff, selected before checking model presence; quote age <=120min in saved-time cohort; missing newest model never backfilled
roster: Same exact issued year/round/gameNo/market/line, complete 2/3-way vectors; no half/full substitution; canonical first alias for duplicate retrospective issued products before outcome inspection
pair_frames: All revisions of held-out events, latest full state first; only quotes captured before placement and kickoff >=30min later. Empty/model-missing frames invalidate old state
second_split: Mandatory sensitivity, not choose the better split
label_timing: Train labels restricted to kickoff < first validation decision minus48h; validation labels restricted to kickoff < first test decision minus48h. Actual result receipt timestamps unproven: embargo is conservative assumption, not proof
weighting: Equal total weight per physical event across multiple market rosters
parameter_selection: Temperature by training multiclass logloss, external weight by validation multiclass logloss; never holdout ROI. Missing training30/validation10 rosters -> learned candidates explicitly unavailable
league_shrinkage: Validation league optimum weight shrunk n/(n+50) toward global; train temperature shrunk n/(n+100) toward global. Small league samples fall back to global, and are labeled
raw_vote_semantics: Vote fractions are support, not calibrated probabilities. Raw vote reference gets hit/forced-ticket diagnostics only; conditional EV requires a market-anchored or fitted candidate
ticket_rules: forced2: top probability choices per distinct event
ticket_constraints: One ticket per model/rule/cohort/league/day/issued round; no odds upper cap; two distinct events, no shared teams; earliest feasible common candidate checkpoint; no second eligible leg means no bet
selection_comparison: Coverage-aware model policies evaluated on common opportunity session universe, skipped session net0; also exact common placed-session and same-legs separate-singles controls
price: Singles original2decimal price; pair product floor2decimal then ceiling1decimal; void legs1.00; allvoid refund; actual labels, not independent-outcome simulation
adoption: No adoption from exposed retrospective archives or sparse perleague profits; candidate must improve calibration and economic results across splits with adequate independent dates and verified pregame prices
papers: Guo et al2017 temperature scaling (general classification, not sportsROI)
Kull et al2017 beta calibration/small-sample isotonic hazards
Walsh and Joshi2024 sports calibration vs accuracy (single-season study, not transferableROI)

audit_addendum.reason: After v1 descriptive run, source contract inspection showed current documented policy is unique-vote direction using market probability, not fixed9:1. Add an untuned current-contract reference, do not optimize or change existing candidates.
audit_addendum.selection: Unique plurality vote direction only, ties abstain; rank and EV use saved market probability, not vote share; probability quality metrics explicitly market-reference while accuracy measures the vote decision
audit_addendum.freeze_status: Original v1 results inspected; this is a transparent baseline correction, not a fresh preregistered winning model

metadata_quality_addendum.reason: Independent source audit found 6 explicit publication timestamps at/after kickoff and one duplicate document credited to two authors. Correct input validity, not pick profitability; preserve v1 descriptive outputs.
rules: Exclude any forecast with aware claimed published_at>=kickoff, regardless result
Deduplicate event+document_hash votes; if one document contradicts itself discard the whole conflicting document
After filtering, aggregate remaining actual author/document votes; no surviving vote means event not eligible for common tipster comparison
Unknown publication time stays explicitly unproven and cannot be called pregame-certified
metadata_quality_addendum.timing: V1 results were inspected before metadata audit correction; corrected replay remains retrospective, not newly preregistered or untouched
